# Ip2Location

IP2Location.io provides fast and accurate IP geolocation data, including country, city, ISP, latitude, longitude, and more, supporting both IPv4 and IPv6 lookups.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/ip2location/.

## Actions

- **Bulk IP Geolocation** (read-only): Retrieve geolocation information for multiple IP addresses in bulk.
- **Check IP2Location API Credits** (read-only): Check remaining IP2Location API credits.
- **IP2Location Get IP Geolocation** (read-only): Retrieve geolocation data for an IP address.
- **IP2Proxy: Get Proxy Detection** (read-only): Detect if an IP is a proxy, VPN, or TOR exit node.
- **IP2WHOIS Domain WHOIS Lookup** (read-only): Retrieve WHOIS information for a domain.
- **IP2WHOIS Hosted Domains Lookup** (read-only): Retrieve hosted domains for a given IP address.
- **IP2Location Distance Calculator** (read-only): Calculate distance between two IPs.
- **IP2Location List IPs** (read-only): List a curated set of test IPv4 and IPv6 addresses.
